mapper.select: SELECT status, failure_count AS failureCount, dlq_enqueued AS dlqEnqueued FROM mq_consumer_inbox WHERE consumer_name=#{consumer} AND event_id=#{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_consumer_inbox SET status='PROCESSING' WHERE consumer_name=#{consumer} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND status='FAILED' AND dlq_enqueued=0
UPDATE mq_consumer_inbox SET status='DONE',completed_time=now(3),error_message=NULL WHERE consumer_name=#{consumer} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE mq_consumer_inbox SET failure_count=failure_count+1,error_message=#{error} WHERE consumer_name=#{consumer} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND status='FAILED' AND dlq_enqueued=0
UPDATE mq_consumer_inbox SET dlq_enqueued=1 WHERE consumer_name=#{consumer} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND status='FAILED' AND dlq_enqueued=0
